title: Bridge Quantity Standard: Courtesy Reships That Carry the Customer to the Next Refill
content:
On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program the days a courtesy reship covers depend on how soon the customer's next refill may ship.

**Days until the next refill may ship.** They are the supply days of the refill stood in for, less the tier's refill ship lead days, less the calendar days since its ship date.

**Standard.** When the days until the next refill may ship are more than 30, the days the reship covers are those days instead of the 30-day block, so that it bridges the customer to the next refill; when they are 0 or fewer, the reship instead replaces every unit of the refill, one for one, and no other rule changes it; and when they are 1 to 30, it keeps the 30-day block.

| Tier | Refill ship lead, days |
|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 7 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 7 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 10 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 10 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 10 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 7 |

| Days until the next refill may ship | Days the courtesy reship covers |
|---|---|
| 31 or more | those days, in place of the 30-day block |
| 1 to 30 | the 30-day block |
| 0 or fewer | none reckoned; every unit of the refill is replaced one for one |

**Cases (hypothetical; a refill of 90 days on a tier with a 10-day ship lead)**

- Shipped 25 days ago: 90 less 10 less 25 is 55 days, more than 30, so the reship covers 55 days.
- Shipped 50 days ago: 30 days, so the reship keeps the 30-day block. Shipped 49 days ago: 31 days, so it covers 31 days.
- Shipped 80 days ago: 0 days, so every unit of the refill is replaced one for one.
